_readme: Non-secret settings for the Meta Ads crew. The access token is NEVER stored here — see meta-ads-crew/README.md (Setup). Money values are NZD.

targets._note: MER = total store revenue / total Meta spend over the same window. Breakeven ROAS is set by gross margin. Update these with your real numbers.

guardrails._note: Hard limits enforced by tools/meta.mjs, not just by the prompts. Raise them deliberately, in a commit.

optimize._note: Ollie's kill/keep rules. High-AOV stone pieces need more spend before a verdict than a $30 DTC product — thresholds are a multiple of each category's target CPA.

scale._note: Scott's rules. A winner must beat target on BOTH ad-level ROAS and blended MER before budget goes up.

slack._note: Optional. Leave channel blank to skip Slack; the Claude app's own notification still tells you a run is ready.
